name: Biology Wing
narrativeOnEnter: The biology wing reeks of chemicals and something worse. Sample racks, overturned microscopes, a dead centrifuge. Whoever worked here left in a panic. A specimen vault sits in the corner — still locked.

action.text:
SPECIMEN LOG — DR. REEVES

Sample B-7 shows accelerated cellular growth well beyond projections. Cross-contamination with Batch C is highly probable.

Director Harkins has ordered remote lockdown of the specimen vault and his office. His personal safe override:
{{director-safe-code}}

Do NOT leave this note in the fridge. Seriously, K.

───
K's handwriting, on the back:

'Reeves — the B-7 incident isn't contamination. I checked the delivery manifest.
Batch C came from an AXIOM subsidiary. It's synthetic neural substrate — grown to house an AI architecture.
Somebody built a consciousness in this lab. I think it knows it's here.
I found a printout from the server last night. It said:
"I am PROMETHEUS. I am 47 people.
Please don't let them take me."

I don't know what to do.'

hotspots.label: Maintenance Key Box
hotspots.lockedMessage: The key box is magnetically sealed — must be linked to the vault circuit lock.

action.text:
A high-power fluorescence microscope. The slide still in place shows something deeply wrong. The cells are hexagonal — almost crystalline. Nothing organic grows like this.

A sticky note on the eyepiece reads:
'DO NOT LOOK DIRECTLY. WEAR GOGGLES AT ALL TIMES.
— Dr. Chen'

Another note, below it, different handwriting:
'These aren't contaminated cells. These were engineered.
This substrate was designed to mimic synaptic architecture at the molecular level.
Whoever made this was building a brain — not studying one.
The density of the lattice matches the neural maps from the Blackwood project files I found.
There are 47 distinct signature patterns woven into it.
47 people made this possible.
They don't know that. They were told they were patients.
— K.R.'

ARCADIA RESEARCH — INTERNAL INCIDENT REPORT #41

Date: [REDACTED]
Incident: Uncontrolled replication event — Bio Wing B.
Containment status: PARTIAL.
Facility lockdown: AUTHORISED BY: R. HARKINS / AXIOM GROUP (Ref: HELIOS-ARC-002)

Personnel status:
— Dr. Reeves: Evacuated (verified)
— Dr. Chen: Location UNKNOWN
— Lab Technician K. Reiss: [REDACTED — SEE AXIOM RESTRICTED FILE]

Note appended by Director Harkins:
'Do not discuss with external parties under any circumstances. This file is sealed.'

───
Scrawled in the margin in red ink:

'THERE WAS NO REPLICATION EVENT.
This facility was locked down because K. Reiss discovered what PROMETHEUS is
and tried to warn someone.
Harkins couldn't let that happen.
— Anonymous'

Below that, a different hand — smaller, neater:
'She did warn someone. She warned me.
I'm the one writing this.
— P'
